observes: AUDITD, attribution controls for query_nodes(limit): a harness cursor in a child process sending the product statement SELECT node_id FROM Graph_KG.nodes FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY exits -11 (SIGSEGV) in both insertion orders; the TOP spelling SELECT TOP 2 node_id FROM Graph_KG.nodes returns 0 and answers [so17:0,so17:1] forward vs [so17:4,so17:3] reverse: the FETCH FIRST crash is the engine/driver behaviour on this setup (IRIS 2026.1 Community, intersystems_irispython 5.3.2) that query_nodes walks into without its own _fetch_first_unsafe check (F-C1743), and the unordered prefix it would take follows insertion order (F-C1742)
